wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-001 wires the DMX sound effect lump expansion (DS-prefixed entries from 05-006) and the per-lump header/sample-rate/sample-count metadata into a runtime sound table. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/sfxLoader.ts iterates the SoundAndMusicAssetCatalog.sfxLumps array, reads each entry's bytes via the injected SfxLumpReader, parses via the read-only parseSfxLump helper, and produces a frozen SfxLoader with both an array (preserving directory order) and a Map<string, SfxLump> for O(1) name lookup. Failure modes (header too short, non-digital format, body length mismatch) surface as typed SfxLoaderError instances.
publicSurface: SfxLoaderError extends Error (reason: SfxLoaderErrorReason, lumpName: string)
